<h2 align="center">Emix {{VERSION}}</h2>
<p align="center"><b>Connect Without Compromise.</b> Private messaging, high-quality voice and video calls, and screen sharing.</p>

## Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| **`Emix-{{VERSION}}-win-x64.exe`** | Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit (most PCs) |
| `Emix-{{VERSION}}-win-arm64.exe` | Windows on ARM |

The easiest way to get the current version is **[getemix.com/download/windows](https://getemix.com/download/windows)**. Prefer the browser? Open **[app.getemix.com](https://app.getemix.com)**.

## Install

1. Download the installer for your PC from the list below.
2. Run it. The installer is not yet code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first install: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Sign in with your Emix account. Emix is invite-only; you need an invitation from an Emix administrator.

Already installed? Emix updates itself automatically. `latest.yml` and the `.blockmap` files are used by the updater; you don't need to download them.
